profile.name: OBI
profile.title: EXPERIENCED PROGRAMMER & BLENDER ANIMATOR
profile.bio: I am a student-athlete and an experienced developer with 9 years of specific expertise in ROBLOX Lua. Beyond Lua, I have extensive programming experience in Java, C#, Python, and F#. I've worked on high-impact projects, including developing 'Metanoia' (a Top 5% grossing game), and I have a strong background in competitive robotics (FTC). Whether I'm in class, at practice, or traveling, I'm always building.

videos.title: METANOIA - TOP 5% GROSSING GAME
videos.description: High-impact Roblox game project featuring modular netcode, optimized framework architecture, custom combat replication, and dynamic spatial HUD systems.

videos.title: BLENDER 3D COMBAT REEL
videos.description: Hyper-stylized character motion, keyframed attacks, dynamic camera framing, and custom particle effect timing designed for seamless game engine import.

videos.title: FTC COMPETITION ROBOTICS CONTROL
videos.description: Autonomous trajectory math, PID closed-loop feedback motor tuning, real-time sensor processing, and custom tele-operated drivers built for FTC robotics.

videos.title: PERSONA-INSPIRED SPATIAL UI ENGINE
videos.description: Custom client-side UI rendering engine supporting spring-physics motion, dynamic screen slashes, angled masked containers, and custom canvas positioning.

videos.title: AUTOMATED BUILD & ASSET PIPELINE
videos.description: Tooling scripts for automated asset compression, map data serialization, build validation, and Roblox model syncing across multi-developer teams.
